items.title: Over four decades, Patrick Case reshaped Ontario schools. The human rights lawyer remembered as a ‘quiet warrior’ by friends
items.summary: Human rights lawyer Patrick Case, who died Nov. 9, helped build the foundation for equity and discrimination policies in Ontario schools today.

items.title: Toronto police to announce results of organized crime, tow truck industry probe
items.summary: Additional charges will be laid on Manoharan (Mano) Subramaniam, owner of a Scarborough auto lot sources link to GTA’s “tow truck turf wars.”

items.title: ‘United we stand’: Doug Ford pitches Quebec-Ontario unity, slams Donald Trump
Bill proposing changes to medical assistance in dying law passes hurdle in Commons
items.summary: The Liberal government’s bill proposing changes to Canada’s medical assistance in dying law will be studied by the House of Commons justice and human rights committee after it passed second reading Tuesday.
